name: sequence-analysis-msa
description: Analyze protein sequence for homologs and build multiple sequence alignment. PSI-BLAST iteratively searches UniRef90/UniProt for homologous sequences using position-specific scoring matrices. HHblits performs HMM-HMM comparison against UniClust30 for more sensitive remote homology detection. The resulting MSA captures evolutionary conservation patterns that inform structure prediction. MUSCLE and MAFFT produce high-quality alignments for downstream modeling.
